map.→ 打开参数数量估算工具: -> Open the Parameter Count Estimator tool
map.为什么卷积层参数量远小于全连接？: Why Do Convolution Layers Have Far Fewer Parameters Than Fully Connected Layers?
map.偏置是否总要加？: Should the Bias Always Be Added?
map.全连接参数 = in × out + out（偏置）；3×3 卷积参数 = in: Fully connected parameters = in × out + out (bias); 3×3 convolution parameters = in × out × 9 + out; memory MB = parameters × 4 / 1024 / 1024
map.全连接层参数=(输入维度+1)×输出维度，+1 为偏置。: Fully connected layer parameters = (input dimension + 1) × output dimension, where +1 is the bias.
map.卷积层参数=(k²×C_in+1)×C_out，k 为核边长；深度可分离卷积参数: Convolution layer parameters = (k²×C_in+1)×C_out, where k is the kernel side length; depthwise separable convolution reduces the parameter count significantly.
map.卷积权值共享且局部连接，参数只与核大小、通道数有关，与特征图尺寸无关；全连接则随: Convolution weights are shared and locally connected, so the parameter count depends only on the kernel size and the number of channels, not on the feature map size; a fully connected layer instead grows with the product of the input and output dimensions.
map.参数量直接决定显存(≈参数量×精度字节)与推理延迟，是轻量化设计的核心约束。: The parameter count directly determines GPU memory (≈ parameter count × bytes per value) and inference latency, making it the core constraint in lightweight design.
map.并非必须。BN 后接的卷积常设 bias=False 以免冗余；最后一层或需学习: Not necessarily required. A convolution after BN is often set to bias=False to avoid redundancy; keep the bias on the final layer or when the intercept needs to be learned.
map.按层的权重矩阵规模累加估算参数量，再按每参数 4 字节（FP32）折算显存。这只: Accumulate the weight-matrix size per layer to estimate the parameter count, then convert it to GPU memory at 4 bytes per parameter (FP32). This is only the lower bound for inference weights; training additionally holds gradients, optimiser state (another 2× with Adam) and activations, so actual usage is typically 4–6× the weight size.
map.输入层宽、卷积核数与通道数，估算全连接层与卷积层参数量，适用于模型规模评估、显存: Enter the layer width, number of kernels and number of channels to estimate the parameter counts of the fully connected and convolutional layers, for model size evaluation, memory budgeting and lightweight design.
map.：3×3 卷积、输入通道 64、输出通道 128：参数=(3²×64+1)×12: : for a 3×3 convolution with 64 input channels and 128 output channels, the parameters =(3²×64+1)×128=(576+1)×128=73728. If changed to depthwise separable, (3×3×64+1×64×128)=576+8192=8768, only about 12% of the original.
